notes: «قالا حدثنا زهير» : Fadl b. Dukayn and Yahya b. Adam are one pair at one level
«عن أبيه، وعلقمة، عن عبد الله» : the father of Abd al-Rahman and Alqama are co-transmitters from Abdullah, one level (rule 2); «أبيه» is by relation only
The saying is Abdullah's narration; the later «ورأيت أبا بكر وعمر» is his words, not a link
